why: Three real plans, an add-on, and a comparison table, which is the shape that produces one window too many. Kept because the extra window is a known limit rather than a bug to be tuned away, and freezing it means an improvement has to say so.
known_wrong: `### Custom Agents` is an add-on and `## Plans and features` is the comparison table; neither is a plan. An add-on is a heading with a price under it, which is exactly a plan's shape - only meaning separates them (BENCHMARKS.md Run 7). If a change makes this list three entries, that is a fix: update this expectation and delete this note.
